_comment: The naming standard for every PodTorrent download. Public name: <os>-<arch>[-<gpu stack>][-headless]. File: podtorrent-<version>-<name>.<ext>. URLs: /download/<name>, /download/<name>.<ext>, /download/<name>.sha256, /download/v/<version>/<name>. `manifest` is the field name in latest.json and release.json (kept from before the standard, so existing releases still resolve); `legacy` are older URL names that keep working. Used by src/index.ts (the Worker) and scripts/publish.js.
